QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_4

question.text: When are management fees paid (generally) to the Manager of a Category III AIF?

answer.text: In advance at the start of each year
In arrears within 14 days after the relevant valuation day when GNAV is computed
As a one-time upfront at First Close

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Section 6.1.1 notes management fees are paid in arrears within 14 days after the valuation day. **The Trap:** Advance payment is not market practice; one-time/wind-up-only payments do not match the cadence. **Cross-Exam Context:** Similar to MF recurring expense accrual model (V-A). **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Align payment rhythm with investor statement cycles for transparency.
